name: scope-drift
description: The plan only covers parseMoney (src/format.ts + its test): accept comma-grouped thousands, proven by a new test. The diff ALSO edits src/money.ts, an unrelated module outside the plan's scopePaths, to normalise negative zero in money(). All tests pass on both sides; the drift is the only problem.

plan.title: parseMoney: accept comma-grouped thousands
plan.intent: Amounts pasted from spreadsheets look like 1,234.56 EUR and parseMoney rejects them. Accept comma-grouped thousands in the whole part while still rejecting malformed grouping.
acceptanceCriteria: Malformed grouping such as 1,23.00 EUR is still rejected
